records.title: Reinforcement Learning with a Terminator
records.abstract: Defines the Termination Markov Decision Process (TerMDP), an MDP extension in which episodes may be interrupted by an external non-Markovian observer. Useful as a contrast to this project's voluntary self-termination action.

records.title: Check Yourself Before You Wreck Yourself: Selectively Quitting Improves LLM Agent Safety
records.abstract: Studies quitting as a safety mechanism for LLM agents in multi-turn tool-use settings and reports improved safety-helpfulness tradeoffs under explicit quit instructions.

records.title: HAICOSYSTEM: An Ecosystem for Sandboxing Safety Risks in Human-AI Interactions
records.abstract: Presents a modular sandbox environment for simulating multi-turn human-AI interactions with tool use and evaluating safety across operational, content-related, societal, and legal risks.
